title: UserSimulatorManifest
description: Metadata file (simulator.json) that every user simulator under ./simulators/<simulator_id>/ MUST publish. A simulator is NOT a subprocess and NOT an external LLM. It is a ROLE PROFILE that the host evaluation-expert agent itself plays in STEP 3, using its OWN LLM brain — exactly the same brain that runs STEP 1.5 / STEP 4 / STEP 8 / STEP 9. The manifest captures the persona/voice the agent should adopt when impersonating a customer; the actual decision text is produced by the agent's own LLM each turn, then handed to the runtime_driver subprocess for I/O. Symmetric to runtime_driver.schema.json by purpose, but DIFFERENT in execution model: drivers ARE subprocesses, simulators are NOT.

simulator_id.description: Stable identifier. MUST equal the simulator's directory basename. Referenced by EvaluationContext.runtime_simulator.simulator_id.

version.description: Semver-style version of this simulator profile.

kind.description: Simulator family. 'llm_persona' is the primary kind: the host agent's LLM consumes system_prompt + per-turn placeholders and emits a SimulatorDecision. 'scripted_replay' / 'rule_based' are escape hatches for offline replay or deterministic regression and are NOT in scope for v2.0.

system_prompt.description: Relative path (within the simulator directory) to the system-prompt template file. The template MAY contain placeholders such as {{customer_persona}}, {{goal}}, {{stop_conditions}}, {{context}}, {{current_emotion}}, {{dialog_so_far}}, {{effective_max_turns}}; the host agent expands them each turn before consulting its own LLM. Typical value: 'system_prompt.md'.

produces.description: Every turn the host agent MUST shape its output as a SimulatorDecision conforming to this schema BEFORE forwarding next_utterance to the driver and BEFORE appending the decision to ExecutionTrace.simulator_trail. Pinned literally so the contract stays checkable, but the schema is enforced by the agent's own scoring/parsing — not by a subprocess boundary.

consumes.description: Inputs the host agent must consult while playing this simulator role. Minimum: enriched_test_case (persona/goal/stop_conditions/opening_message) + the in-progress execution_trace (dialog so far + previous simulator_trail entries).

capabilities.description: Optional self-declared capabilities the role profile expects the host agent to honor.

notes.description: Optional human-readable notes for simulator authors / reviewers.
